{{Quote|This bodes well for the peace process. Thank you, Lieutenant Tavus, and you, Master Orgus, for your report and your valiant service.|Supreme Chancellor Berooken|<ref name="ToP1" />}}
'''Berooken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] politician who served as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the latter days of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Berooken was in [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]] in [[3653 BBY]], when the Empire's [[Dark Council]] proposed that the two governments convene to discuss the possibility of a peace agreement after nearly three decades of war. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] agreed to the call for peace, but the Chancellor chose not to attend the [[Alderaan peace conference|peace summit]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] on the advice of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. In the Chancellor's place, Berooken sent the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] to represent the Republic Senate in the conference.

The summit ultimately turned out to be nothing more than a diversion crafted by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in order to draw attention away from their true target&mdash;the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While the delegates from the Republic and Empire began their deliberations on Alderaan, the Sith attacked the capital in a massive invasion that came to be known as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. During the attack, the leader of the Sith force, [[Darth Angral]], breached the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Supreme Chancellor Berooken. As a result of the Sacking of Coruscant and Berooken's death, Senator Am-Ris was forced to agree to the Sith-authored [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which firmly placed the Republic as the war's loser.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I could've exterminated every Jedi on Coruscant, but ''you'' didn't give me enough time!''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''I'' was following the plan! Your improvisational slaughter of the Supreme Chancellor nearly got me killed!|Sith Lords Angral and Baras argue over the attack on Coruscant|<ref name="ToP1" />}}
In [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] emerged from hiding in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and launched a interstellar conflict of unrivaled proportions that quickly spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> This [[Great Galactic War]] between the Empire and the preeminent galactic government, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], dragged on for twenty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and crippled the Republic both [[Politics/Legends|politically]] and [[Galactic economy|economically]].<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> In the latter stages of the war, Berooken, a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] politician, was elected to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|position]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], the leader of the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During Berooken's term in [[3654 BBY]], the Senate was presented with a proposal for peace from the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]. Having narrowly survived twenty-eight years of war and several supply crises, the Senate welcomed the potential respite, however suspicious the offer may have been. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was much less eager to believe the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and advised the Senate and the Chancellor to ignore the apparent trap. Although the Senate overruled the Jedi and accepted the offer, the Council managed to convince Chancellor Berooken to remain on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the deliberations.<ref name="JoMGD" />

[[File:Minos_Cluster_report.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Chancellor Berooken presides over the hearing regarding the Minos Cluster.]]
The arrangements were made for a [[Alderaan peace conference|peace summit]] to be held on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> To represent the Republic on Alderaan, Chancellor Berooken selected [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]], who was accompanied to the planet by a delegation from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order, consisting of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dar'Nala]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]], and several others. While the Republic and Imperial delegations convened to discuss a possible cessation of hostilities, Berooken presided over a session of the Galactic Senate. During the session, the congress heard the testimonies of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]] and [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] regarding the Sith withdrawal from the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The Chancellor was encouraged by their reports, stating that the end of the Empire's [[Minos Cluster Campaign|offensive]] in the Cluster was a positive sign that peace between the two superpowers was possible.<ref name="ToP1" />

In truth, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were wholly uninterested in a ceasefire with the Republic; the Empire sought victory, and used the conference on Alderaan as a diversion from its true goal&mdash;Coruscant itself. As the Senate session came to a close, Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|battle cruisers]] entered the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and began bombarding the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. The leader of the Sith assault, [[Darth Angral]], disembarked his [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] and led a contingent of [[Imperial soldier]]s in a raid outside the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]]. Berooken was able to leave the Senate Chamber and make it to the executive offices, where the Chancellor contacted Senator Am-Ris to warn him of the Empire's deception<ref name="ToP1" /> while the office staff fled the building.<ref name="ToR:D" /> As Berooken demanded that the Cerean break off the peace talks, Angral broke through the wall of the office and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Chancellor,<ref name="ToP1" /> [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] him.<ref name="SWTOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Berooken's death was witnessed by the Republic and Jedi delegation on Alderaan, sparking a short [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between Satele Shan and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Baras|Baras]], the Sith delegate.<ref name="ToP1" /> As the Sith forces settled in to begin an occupation of the Coruscant, Angral adopted the Chancellor's office as his own while overseeing the operation.<ref name="ToR:D" />

The attack on the capital, which came to be known as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], gutted both the Republic and the Jedi Order. The delegation on Alderaan was forced to submit to Imperial demands and sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]&mdash;a Sith-authored document that was heavily biased toward the Empire and firmly placed the Republic as the loser of the Great Galactic War. In the period that immediately followed the signing of the treaty, Am-Ris stepped in as an interim Supreme Chancellor to fill the void left in the aftermath of Berooken's murder.<ref name="ToP1" /> When the Senate reconvened for the first time following the attack, it [[Supreme Chancellor election, 3653 BBY|unanimously elected]] Senator [[Dorian Janarus]] of Coruscant to relieve Am-Ris of the position.<ref name="Janarus">{{HolonetOld|biographies|supreme-chancellor-janarus|Supreme Chancellor Janarus}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Senator Am-Ris&hellip;break off the talks! It's a trick! The Sith! They're&hellip;they're attacking&hellip;they're here!-- No!|Berooken's last words|<ref name="ToP1" />}}
Berooken had [[blue]] skin,<ref name="ToP1" /> a coloration uncommon for members of the Mon Calamari [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Berooken decorated the executive [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|offices]] with a number of art pieces, including bone carvings from the Mon Calamari [[Dac/Legends|homeworld]], an oil landscape painting from Alderaan, and a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] sculpture reminiscent in design to the mythical [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beasts]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="ToR:D" /> On the day of the Chancellor's death, Berooken garbed himself in a regal [[white]] robe with a high [[Gold/Legends|golden]] collar.<ref name="ToP1" />

[[File:Angral_vs_chancellor_JMGD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The death of Berooken at the hand of Darth Angral.]]
During the war, the Chancellor was grateful for the service performed by the Republic's defenders, and made a point to thank Master Din and Lieutenant Tavus for what Berooken deemed to be "valiant service." Nonetheless, Chancellor Berooken was a proponent for peace in a time when much of the galaxy was embroiled in violent warfare.<ref name="ToP1" /> Although the idea of a ceasefire was not popular with all of the Chancellor's colleagues in the Senate, such as the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] delegation,<ref name="Alderaan">{{Holonet|planets|alderaan|Alderaan}}</ref> Berooken was in agreement with a majority of Republic leaders that it was a proposition worth pursuing.<ref name="ToP1" /><ref name="Timeline 1" /> Berooken intended to be present at the peace conference on Alderaan, but the Jedi High Council was able to talk the Supreme Chancellor out of attending for fear of a Sith betrayal.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Regardless, Berooken remained involved in the peace process and the news that the Sith had ended their offensive in the Minos Cluster encouraged Berooken that peace was indeed a possibility. Upon discovering that the Imperials had no interest in allowing the war to end in a draw, Chancellor Berooken's first priority was to alert Senator Am-Ris on Alderaan and warn him of the Sith attack.<ref name="ToP1" /> Even as Senators and the Chancellor's own office staff fled the Senate Building,<ref name="ToR:D" /> Berooken worked to appraise the Republic delegations of the attack. Berooken's final words were a plea to break off the talks, but they were ultimately disregarded by Am-Ris, who gave in to the demands of the Sith.<ref name="ToP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari Supreme Chancellor was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] created as a prelude to [[LucasArts]]' and [[BioWare]]'s online [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The comic was initially released exclusively online through the [http://www.swtor.com ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' official website], but is currently in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic (comic series)|re-release]] as [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] issues published by [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]]. In the series, the Chancellor appears in only the first issue, [[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant|''Act I: Treaty of Coruscant'']]. The Mon Calamari was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''. In both the comic series and the novel, the Chancellor goes unnamed. Berooken was finally given a name and gender in the 2011 book [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']].
